During February and March we will have our SHOP fully up and running for you. Our partners supply us with only the best from their range. We test it during our training, races and exhibitions, and add to our range everything we would put our hand in the fire for.

POC / MALOJA / LEZYNE / BIKEWORX / SPANK / SUPACAZ and many other brands from the LEVELSPORTKONCEPT portfolio are, in our opinion, among the very best you can buy for your bike.

Special purchase discounts are available for participants of our courses and camps!

You can also treat your loved ones, friends or colleagues. Just give them a Bikeskills voucher, which lets them experience something unusual on a bike while improving their technique.

Of course, if you can't find something in our range, just let us know and we'll get the products for you.

We ship goods cash on delivery or with payment in advance.

AND WATCH OUT – we're preparing our own jerseys and accessories too :)
